- Roast chicken breast with skin
- Braised cabbage/onion with pan juices underneath

- Cabbage: 69 ml × 0.6 ≈ 41 g
- Skin bits: 19 ml × 0.6 ≈ 11 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken (300 g × 190 kcal/100 g) ≈ 570 kcal
- Cabbage (41 g × 60 kcal/100 g) ≈ 25 kcal
- Skin bits (11 g × 450 kcal/100 g) ≈ 50 kcal
- Lettuce ≈ 0 kcal

Total ≈ 645 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A large breast quarter of roughly 300 g plus a few sides is plausible, giving about 353 g and 645 kcal.
